user.title: Connect to Freebox
user.description: Enter your Freebox address. If you haven't changed it, leave the default value.

authorize.title: Freebox Authorization
authorize.description:
1. Go to your Freebox Server unit.
2. Press the **right arrow** on the display to approve the access request (HA CallerID).
3. Return here and click **Submit**.

⚠️ Important: In Freebox OS > Settings > Access Management > Applications, enable **Access to call log** for call detection. To use the contact lookup actions, also enable **Access to contact list**.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: Freebox Caller ID needs to re-authenticate access to your Freebox.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Freebox.
error.auth_failed: The Freebox rejected the authorization request.
error.pending_auth: The authorization has not yet been confirmed on the Freebox.
error.auth_denied: The authorization request was denied or expired.

init.title: Freebox Caller ID Options
init.description: Adjust polling frequency and ringing timeout.

data_description.scan_interval:
A polling interval that is too fast (e.g. 1s) responds quicker but may overload the box.
2 seconds is the default value in order to limit the ring-detection latency. A higher value reduces the number of requests sent to the Freebox, at the expense of detection speed.
data_description.ringing_timeout: Sets the 'ringing' sensor activation duration; defaults to 45s. Answering the phone overrides this setting.

contact_by_number.name: Find contact by phone number
contact_by_number.description: Search contacts using a full or partial number containing at least 3 digits. Spaces, dots, and hyphens are accepted and removed before matching; an initial + is allowed. Without an explicit international prefix, no country is assumed.

phone_number.name: Phone number
phone_number.description: At least 3 digits. Spaces, dots, and hyphens are accepted; an initial + is allowed. The number is normalized before matching.

contact_by_name.name: Find contact by name
contact_by_name.description: Search the Freebox phonebook for contacts whose display name, first name, last name, or company contains the specified text. Search is case-insensitive.

name.name: Name
name.description: The name or part of a name to search for.

config_entry_not_found.message: No Freebox Caller ID configuration entry exists.

config_entry_not_loaded.message: The Freebox Caller ID configuration entry is not loaded.

invalid_phone_number.message: The number must contain only digits and optionally a + at the beginning.

search_too_short.message: Name searches must contain at least 3 characters; phone-number searches must contain at least 3 digits.

contacts_permission_denied.message: Access to the Freebox contact list is not authorized. In Freebox OS, open Settings > Access Management > Applications > HA CallerID and enable access to contacts.

invalid_app_token.message: The Freebox application token is invalid or revoked. Reauthorize Freebox Caller ID.

contact_lookup_failed.message: Unable to retrieve contacts from the Freebox. Check the connection and the integration logs.
